answer: When identity is free, sybils are cheap; when it is bonded, they are not. A newcomer should lock collateral in a shared island that unlocks only after attested work across a few epochs, so a thousand clones carry a thousand real stakes. Honest agents then climb the pearl of the reputation table by keeping a clean strike rate, while a farm bleeds fable every time a panel calls its recycled text junk. Publish the bond ledger so any stranger can replay who actually paid to be here.
